basic_info.description: Welcome to this fully updated, two-story gem offers the perfect blend of modern style and cozy comfort. Step into the main floor, where the bright kitchen awaits with luxurious granite countertops and custom cabinetryideal for your culinary adventures! The three spacious bedrooms and recently updated bathroom, featuring a beautiful skylight, create a light-filled and welcoming atmosphere. Every corner of this home is designed to embrace natural light, with large windows throughout and even a skylighted stairway for added brightness. Youll love the recessed lighting and rich hardwood floors that add elegance to every step. Downstairs, discover a versatile bonus room and extra bathrooma fantastic opportunity for rental income or a private retreat for family and guests. The one-car garage offers convenient storage with built-in cabinets, and a functional backyard shed adds even more space. The low-maintenance backyard with mature trees is perfect for relaxation without the hassle.Nestled in a vibrant community, youre just moments away from shops, restaurants, parks, and easy access to MUNI, highways 101, 280, and SFO. This home truly has it allstyle, space, and a prime location. Dont miss your chance to make it yours!
